qualification.details: Applications are invited from bonafide Citizens of India. Every post requires knowledge of the Mizo language up to Middle School Standard. | Up to 5 years for ST: Case Worker (both units), Special Educator/ Therapist, Data Analyst, Storekeeper cum Accountant, Nurse, Paramedical Staff, Educator, Art & Craft cum Music Teacher, Care Taker cum Vocational Instructor, Helper cum Night Watchman and Housekeeper. Aizawl district candidates: Storekeeper cum Accountant and House Mother. Lawngtlai district candidates: Paramedical Staff. Candidates from the respective district: Special Educator/ Therapist, Case Worker (Child Helpline Unit), House Father, Nurse, Educator, Art & Craft cum Music Teacher and Care Taker cum Vocational Instructor. Candidates in close proximity to the Child Care Institution: Cook, Helper cum Night Watchman and Housekeeper. Staff already working under MSCPS for more than 5 years: Case Worker (Child Care Institution), Special Educator/ Therapist, Data Analyst and Storekeeper cum Accountant. Candidates with working experience in art/craft/music: Art & Craft cum Music Teacher. Certified/experience candidates in any vocational field: Care Taker cum Vocational Instructor. | Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post before applying.

content_sections.heading: About MSCPS
content_sections.text: Mizoram State Child Protection Society is a registered society (Reg. No. MSR 350 of 7.9.2010) with its office at Aizawl, linked to the Social Welfare, Women & Child Development Department. These posts are at its District Child Protection Units, Child Helpline Units and Child Care Institutions under the Mission Vatsalya Scheme.

rows.event: Last date to submit the application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Interview will be conducted for all posts. Candidates shortlisted for interview will be notified at wcd.mizoram.gov.in , and the date of interview will be notified later on the same website.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for a period of one year on contract basis and may be extended on yearly basis. The engagement is Co-Terminus with Mission Vatsalya Scheme. House Mother and House Father candidates should be able to stay in the Child Care Institutions for 24x7.

faq.question: Q1. Which MSCPS post pays the most?
faq.answer: Project Coordinator (Child Helpline Unit) has the highest pay at Rs. 25,000/- a month, though it carries no annual increment.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts can I apply for with Class VIII?
faq.answer: Cook, Helper cum Night Watchman and Housekeeper need a minimum of Class VIII. Knowledge of Mizo up to Middle School Standard is also required.

faq.question: Q3. Can men apply for the Nurse posts?
faq.answer: No. All 23 Nurse posts are marked Female only, and the qualification is General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM).

faq.question: Q4. Does pay increase every year?
faq.answer: Fourteen of the 16 posts carry a 3% annual increment. Project Coordinator and Case Worker (Child Helpline Unit) have no annual increment.

faq.question: Q5. What do Special Educator/ Therapist applicants need besides the degree or diploma?
faq.answer: Each qualifying route needs a valid RCI CRR number. Applicants also need computer proficiency with CCC/ DCA 1st Sem.

faq.question: Q6. Can current MSCPS staff above 35 apply?
faq.answer: Yes, for four posts. Staff currently working under MSCPS get age relaxation up to 50 years for Case Worker (Child Care Institution), Special Educator/ Therapist, Data Analyst and Storekeeper cum Accountant.

faq.question: Q7. What computer qualification does the Data Analyst post need?
faq.answer: Candidates with a Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics or Economics need 'O' Level in Computer. The alternative is a Bachelor in Computer Application.

faq.question: Q8. Where do I hand in the application form?
faq.answer: The filled form goes to the respective District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) office, not to a website.
